title: Imperfect cross-sensor references for Sentinel-2 super-resolution: code, results and derived data
description: Code, configurations, results and derived data of the study of the SEN2NEON benchmark: per-tile registration and compensation of the contrast compression caused by the harmonisation regression, and their consequences for training and evaluating deep super-resolution networks for the Sentinel-2 20 m bands. The archive of the large files (corrected references of the real-data domain and model weights) is published as a separate dataset record (see the README).
